{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data structure
print('Data shape:', df.shape)
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for missing values and sentinel values
print('\nMissing values per column:')
print(df.isnull().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age: -1
print('\nNumber of customer_age == -1:', (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue: it's a string with commas
print('\nSample of revenue values:')
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for the six QA orders with 999999.99 revenue
print('\nRows with revenue == 999999.99:')
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])

# Check for refunded orders
print('\nNumber of refunded orders:', (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check if revenue is numeric after parsing
print('\nSample of parsed revenue (first 5):')
print(df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float).head())"}
